root_cause_confirmation.mechanism: PyInstaller's bindepend scanned host PATH during Qt6Core analysis and harvested alien ICU78 from external native toolchain (poppler/Library/bin/icuuc.dll), copying it to bundle _internal. Windows loader resolved _internal/icuuc.dll ahead of C:\Windows\System32\icuuc.dll. The alien ICU78 exported only _78-suffixed symbols, lacking the 20 unsuffixed symbols (ucnv_*) demanded by Qt6Core.dll, causing WinError 127 and PySide6.QtGui ImportError.
